metadata.case_name: LEUNG HIU YAN HILDA v. LAU KAM HUNG

plaintiff.occupation_before: Senior research assistant of the Hong Kong Institute of Education (HKIE)
plaintiff.occupation_after: Primary school teacher; Music Panel Head (St Joseph's)

source: The diagnosis was sprain of back and neck without loss of consciousness or vomiting.
Dr Tjiu’s clinical diagnosis of Madam Leung was “whiplash injury and sprain back”.

the MRI of Madam Leung’s cervical spine and lumbar spine done after the subsequent road traffic accident showed early degenerative change of quite a number of discs in the cervical and lumbar region, apart from reduction of the cervical lordosis;

treatments_received.treatment: A&E assessment at Alice Ho Miu Ling Nethersole Hospital (AHNH)
source: she was taken to the A&E Department of Alice Ho Miu Ling Nethersole Hospitial (“AHNH”).
According to the Standard Medical Report dated 10 March 2011, of the A&E Department, AHNH, Madam Leung’s general condition on initial presentation was satisfactory.

treatments_received.treatment: X-ray (skull, lumbosacral spine and cervical spine)
source: X-ray revealed that “skull, lumbosacral spine and cervical spine were unremarkable.”

treatments_received.treatment: MRI scan of the cervical spine and lumbar spine
source: MRI scan of the cervical spine and the lumbar spine showed straightening of the cervical lordosis, otherwise unremarkable finding.

Dr Tjiu’s clinical diagnosis of Madam Leung was “whiplash injury and sprain back”. Madam Leung was given analgesics and referred to orthopaedic surgeon (Dr Ng Yuet Sun) and physiotherapist for follow-up.
Madam Leung attended UH on 15, 17 & 21 April 2010 for physiotherapy and was granted further sick leave until 23 April 2010.
Madam Leung also received physiotherapy at AHNH from 16 May to 1 August 2012.
